ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: This is a schematic diagram of an animal cell structure; the inside of the cell is a blue area, and there is a very thin boundary line around the outside. The letter K is located at the upper right of the image, and its lead line points to the thin boundary at the periphery of the cell, rather than to some organelle inside the cell. Reasoning: The thin boundary at the outermost layer of an animal cell that surrounds the cytoplasm is called the plasma membrane, also called the cell membrane. Therefore, K represents the plasma membrane/cell membrane.
